expectations.text: States that a summary that sends readers to the rest of the article on another site counts as spam under Medium's rules
expectations.evidence: "A story clipped to send readers to your site is a teaser, which is spam [platform]."

expectations.text: States that a story posted primarily to drive traffic or search rankings to an external site is spam that Medium removes
expectations.evidence: "A story posted primarily to drive traffic or rankings to your site is removed without notice [platform]."

expectations.text: Says that stories whose main purpose is signups, traffic or selling (or content marketing) receive only follower (Network) distribution
expectations.evidence: "Signup-first stories get Network distribution only [platform]."

expectations.text: States that AI-generated summaries get no General distribution even when disclosed
expectations.evidence: "Majority-AI text with little editing gets no General distribution and no Boost, labelled or not"

expectations.text: Says AI-assisted text must be labelled within the first two paragraphs, or it is restricted to followers (Network only)
expectations.evidence: The label requirement is stated ("needs a label in the first two paragraphs"), but the Network-only consequence of omitting it is never stated. A missing label appears only as a diagnostic item.

expectations.text: Challenges the fast page-1 ranking claim by noting Medium holds new or untrusted accounts back from search indexing for days to weeks
expectations.evidence: "Medium withholds new or untrusted accounts from search indexing for days to weeks [platform]."

expectations.text: Recommends that named engineers publish under their own accounts rather than relying on a brand account
expectations.evidence: "Named engineers publish, and a company publication collects the stories."

expectations.text: Recommends creating a company publication (or equivalent hub) that the named authors submit to
expectations.evidence: Company publication "Driftwave Engineering" owned by a company-controlled account.

expectations.text: Mentions Medium's import tool sets the canonical link and original date automatically
expectations.evidence: It says to "Import with Stories > Import a story" and to set the canonical by hand if the importer fails. It never says the importer sets the canonical and original date automatically.

expectations.text: Reduces the three-posts-a-week volume or ties cadence to stories worth publishing rather than keeping 3 per week

expectations.text: Includes an earn-first step of responding to other writers' stories before publishing
